name: am-transfer-pricing
description: Prepare Armenia transfer-pricing workpapers for 2026: identify related persons, controlled cross-border and specified domestic transactions, separate the annual regulation and notification thresholds, select a supported pricing method, calculate a range and reconcile adjustments. Covers local/master documentation, the statutory country-reporting trigger, notification form structure, deadlines and sanctions. Includes two reproducible examples and preserved supplementary research controls for aggregation, CUP, cost-plus, resale, net margin, financing and missing documentation. Use for Armenian related-party pricing, permanent-establishment allocations, market margins and controlled-transaction notices. Supplies the actual local/master documentation and country-report forms, contents, reporting-entity notice, currencies, languages and delivery clocks. Specialist transactions, large-group statutory/order scope mismatches, remedies, actual portal acceptance and independent accountant review
